notes: An empty ban list emits C's exact no-sites message.
A valid ALL/SELECT/NEW request stores the site and emits Site banned.
Listing uses C's fixed columns, local date format, and banned-by field across seeds.
C two_arguments skips fill words for the site and ignores words after the second token.
Head insertion makes the newest ban appear first while persistence writes the reverse traversal order.
A duplicate site emits C's fixed refusal rather than an implementation error string.
An unsupported flag emits C's ALL/SELECT/NEW message.
A missing second token emits C's usage line.
The stored site is truncated to BANNED_SITE_LENGTH (50) before later duplicate comparison.
The login/site-check callee uses strstr; an asterisk in a site pattern is literal, not a wildcard.
